youtubeTitle: He dug a pit of mud to practice high jump. He won Paralympic gold anyway.
caption:
He dug a pit of mud to practice high jump. He won Paralympic gold anyway.

Praveen Kumar, the son of a poor farmer near Jewar in Gautam Buddha Nagar district, was born with a congenital condition affecting the bones connecting his hip to his left leg. During COVID lockdowns, with stadiums closed, he dug a small pit near his house and filled it with soft mud so he could keep training without a landing mattress. He won silver at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics at age 18 with an Asian record of 2.07m in the T64 high jump, then upgraded to gold at Paris 2024 with a new Asian record of 2.08m - ahead of competitors from the US and Uzbekistan.
